problems.evidence: round-0-main-desktop-light.png, round-0-main-desktop-dark.png and round-0-main-desktop-light-s1.png: at 1440px, the cart's right edge cuts through line totals; Total heading and remove controls are outside the initial visible region. The late viewport rule forces at least 888px of row width into the visibly narrower cart. Horizontal scrolling is an available workaround, so this is clipping rather than proven inability to complete a sale. T2, T6 and the brief's complete-price/total priority apply. Checker corroboration: baseline-geometry.json measures 763px cart client width vs 888px scroll width at 1440 in both themes; 703/888 at 1024. Internal scrolling at narrow tablets is approved, but clipped routine totals at desktop fails the named brief.
problems.fix: Reconcile the POS-only column budget with the actual desktop cart width so default two-unit rows show complete prices, line totals and remove actions together. Preserve one-row tablet composition, 36px controls and internal horizontal scrolling where genuinely necessary for three/four units or large values. Keep header, rows and add row aligned.

problems.evidence: Arrow keys change active and input aria-activedescendant (line 299), but no effect or handler scrolls the corresponding option into view. The list is overflow-y-auto with measured maxHeight (lines 215-220), so keyboard selection can move to an invisible lower result whenever the popup is short. T7 and search readability priority. Checker corroboration: baseline-geometry.json records activeVisible=false in both themes at 320x700 and 1024x768; corresponding baseline-320-light-search.png and baseline-1024-light-search.png were inspected. Related composition defect at ProductCombobox.tsx:179 and CustomerPicker.tsx:89: Enter selects without checking composition; a Bangla IME confirmation may add the highlighted product or choose a customer. T7/T9.
problems.fix: On open/active change, reveal the active option inside the list scroll container with nearest/block geometry, preserving page scroll and reduced-motion behavior; verify at short viewport/open-up states. Guard IME composition before selection/navigation, including supported browser composition-Enter behavior, in the touched product/customer pickers. Prove no query clearing or add during composition, ordinary Enter product→quantity→search, visible active result in short/upward popup, Escape/focus return and touch selection.

problems.evidence: Two-unit selector declares radiogroup/radio with aria-checked but every radio remains a normal Tab stop and no Arrow key or roving tabindex behavior is implemented. Checkout discount group repeats this at CheckoutPanel.tsx:216-225. Users can Tab+Space through it, but the declared radio keyboard model is incomplete. T7; shared keyboard/accessibility contract. Checker ranks P1 because the brief/checker contract treats a verified accessibility failure as P1; existing Tab+Space remains usable.
problems.fix: Implement standard Arrow selection and roving tab focus on these existing compact groups (or use the existing compliant shared radio primitive if geometry remains unchanged). Do not change unit conversion, selected-unit prices or discount calculation.

problems.evidence: Primary completion Button concatenates action label, unbounded formatted total and F9 at lines 363-364. Bundled Button has whitespace-nowrap, while this use has w-full and no wrapping override or separate constrained amount layout. At large BDT values and long Bangla action text it has no way to fit a phone/340px checkout. Main payable at line 247 also uses a 29px unbreakable numeric run without a maximum width. Source establishes missing fallback; exact clipping must be corroborated by independent rendered evidence. T5/T6 and explicit complete-large-values brief.
problems.fix: Keep the same 48px terminal CTA and calculator/state paths, but provide an amount-safe responsive arrangement using existing tokens and readable proportional digits. Permit deliberate wrapping/separate action and amount regions where necessary and validate full large total at 320/390px and in Bangla.
problems.verificationStatus: source-confirmed missing fallback; rendered large-value case must be reproduced before patch acceptance

problems.evidence: Joined control divides width equally among up to four units, has overflow-hidden, and each segment contains a shrink-0 symbol plus numeric input. At <=639px index.css:199 permanently reserves 26px for each compact stepper; label additionally requires 8px padding + border + up to four symbol characters. At a 320px viewport, the cart's available joined width is below 300px, leaving very little number width per segment; configured Gira/Coil/Pair and custom 4-character symbols are supported. No min readable number width or POS opt-in adaptation exists. Exact rendered digits should be confirmed independently. T5/T6 and brief's readable joined 2–4 unit field.
problems.fix: Add a POS-specific opt-in quantity presentation that guarantees readable numeric space for all four segments while retaining one horizontal joined shell, short symbols, 36px height and original conversions. Preserve default shared consumers and existing input/stepper behavior; verify focused/coarse-pointer values and multi-digit entries at 320px.
problems.verificationStatus: source-confirmed compression risk; supported real-preview 3/4-unit case must be reproduced before patch acceptance
